```{r setup}
library("GimmmeMySC")
library("GimmeMyPlot")
library("Seurat")
library("Signac")

source(
  file.path(file.path(
  dirname(getwd()),
  "inst",
  "extdata"
), "conf.R"))

integration_method <- "RPCA"
```

## Data
```{r}
load(file.path(path_root, "rna_bcell_integrated7abcde.rda"))
# load(file.path(path_root, "rna_bcell_wt.rda"))
seurat$labels <- seurat@meta.data[, "SCT_snn_res.0.35"]
seurat <- reorder_idents(seurat, "labels")
seurat$modality <- "RNA"
DefaultAssay(seurat) <- "SCT"
rna <- seurat
rna@meta.data[, "labels"] <- Idents(rna)
```

```{r}
# load(file.path(path_root, "atac_bcell_integrated3.rda"))
load(file.path(path_root, "atac_bcell_integrated4.rda"))
seurat@assays$ATAC_v5 <- NULL
# load(file.path(path_root, "atac_bcell_wt2.rda"))
seurat$labels <- seurat@meta.data[, "SCT_snn_res.0.35"]
seurat <- reorder_idents(seurat, "labels")
seurat$modality <- "ATAC"
DefaultAssay(seurat) <- "SCT"
atac <- seurat
gc()
```

```{r}
options(future.globals.maxSize = 5 * 1024^3)
# seurat <- subset(seurat, subset = Type == target_type)

DefaultAssay(seurat) <- "RNA"
seurat[["RNA"]] <- split(
  seurat[["RNA"]],
  f = seurat[[]][, "Type"],
  layers = c("counts", "data")
)
seurat <- SCTransform(seurat)#, vars.to.regress = c("S.Score", "G2M.Score"))
seurat <- RunPCA(seurat, npcs = max_dim)#, features = VariableFeatures(seurat))

seurat <- IntegrateLayers(
    object = seurat,
    method = get(paste0(integration_method, "Integration")),
    new.reduction = integration_method,
    orig.reduction = reduction,
    dims.to.integrate = dims,
    normalization.method = ifelse(SCT, "SCT", "LogNormalize"),
    verbose = TRUE
)
seurat[["RNA"]] <- JoinLayers(seurat[["RNA"]])

resolution2 <- seq(.1, .4, 0.05)
resolution <- c(seq(.5, 1, by = 0.1), 1.2, 1.5)
resolution_tot <- c(resolution2, resolution)
seurat <- FindNeighbors(
  seurat,
  reduction = integration_method, 
  dims = dims
)

seurat <- FindClusters(
  seurat,
  verbose = FALSE,
  algorithm = 3,
  resolution = resolution_tot,
  graph.name = tail(names(seurat@graphs), 1)
)
seurat <- RunUMAP(
  seurat, 
  dims = dims,
  reduction = integration_method
)

DefaultAssay(seurat) <- "RNA"
seurat <- NormalizeData(seurat) %>%
    FindVariableFeatures() %>%
    ScaleData()

save(seurat, file = file.path(path_root, "atac_bcell_integrated4.rda"))
```

## Learning
```{r}
rna@assays$SCT@scale.data <- matrix()
atac@assays$SCT@scale.data <- matrix()
seurat <- merge(rna, y = atac)
seurat <- JoinLayers(seurat, assay = "RNA")
DefaultAssay(seurat) <- "SCT"

anchors <- FindTransferAnchors(
  reference = rna,
  query = seurat,
  # query.assay = assay,
  normalization.method = ifelse(SCT, "SCT", "LogNormalize"),
  reference.reduction = integration_method,
  # reduction = tolower(integration_method),
  dims = dims
)
```

## Transfer
```{r}
rna2 <- RunUMAP(
  rna,
  dims = dims,
  reduction = integration_method,
  return.model = TRUE
)

seurat <- MapQuery(
    anchorset = anchors,
    query = seurat,
    reference = rna2,
    refdata = list(labels = "labels"),
    reduction.model = "umap"
)

cl_trans <- TransferData(
    anchorset = anchors,
    dims = dims,
    refdata = Idents(rna)
  )
seurat <- AddMetaData(seurat, metadata = cl_trans)
seurat <- reorder_idents(seurat, "predicted.labels")
seurat$modality <- fct_relevel(seurat$modality, "RNA")
```

## Session information
